npc_dota_hero_treant.description: Leech Seed can be ground targeted to plant a tree.

npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.name: ogre_magi_fat_chance

npc_dota_hero_ogre_magi.description: Each point of Ogre Magi's Strength adds {s:bonus_strength_mult}% to Ogre Magi's Multicast chance.

npc_dota_hero_undying.title: Rotting Mitts
npc_dota_hero_undying.description: While transformed into a Flesh Golem, attacks spawn a zombie.

npc_dota_hero_rubick.name: rubick_arcane_accumulation
npc_dota_hero_rubick.title: Arcane Accumulation

npc_dota_hero_disruptor.name: disruptor_thunderstorm

npc_dota_hero_disruptor.name: disruptor_line_walls
npc_dota_hero_disruptor.title: Kinetic Fence
npc_dota_hero_disruptor.description: Replaces Kinetic Field with the ability to create impassable walls.

npc_dota_hero_disruptor.name: disruptor_conduit
npc_dota_hero_disruptor.title: Transference

npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.name: nyx_assassin_burn_mana
npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.title: Mana Burn
npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.description: Mind Flare burns a percentage of the target's max mana.

npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.name: nyx_assassin_scuttle
npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.title: Scuttle
npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.description: For the first {s:bonus_free_pathing_duration}s of Vendetta, Nyx Assassin is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.

npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.name: naga_siren_passive_riptide
npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.title: Rip Tide
npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.description: Every 6 attacks from Naga and her illusions, enemies around them are damaged and their Armor is reduced.

npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.name: naga_siren_active_riptide
npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.title: Deluge
npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.description: Naga Siren can create a splash around herself and her illusions, damaging enemies and capping their max movement speed.

npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.name: keeper_of_the_light_facet_solar_bind
npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.title: Solar Bind
npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.description: Grants the Solar Bind ability while active.

npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.name: keeper_of_the_light_facet_recall
npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light.title: Recall

After a short delay, teleports the targeted friendly hero to your location. If the targeted friendly hero takes player based damage during this time, the ability is interrupted. When cast, the teleport target's movement speed is increased. Upon teleporting, the increased movement speed buff are applied to both Keeper of the Light and the teleport target, and the latter also receives a Chakra Magic.

 If alt-cast, teleports Keeper of the Light to the target Ally instead. 

 Ability Level increases with levels of Spirit Form.

npc_dota_hero_wisp.name: wisp_kritzkrieg
npc_dota_hero_wisp.title: Kritzkrieg
npc_dota_hero_wisp.description: Overcharge grants attack speed and spell amplification to Io and any Tethered allies.

npc_dota_hero_wisp.name: wisp_medigun
npc_dota_hero_wisp.title: Medigun
npc_dota_hero_wisp.description: Overcharge grants armor and magic resistance to Io and any Tethered allies.

npc_dota_hero_visage.name: visage_sepulchre
npc_dota_hero_visage.title: Sepulchre
npc_dota_hero_visage.description: Grave Chill also affects units around the target. Visage can also recall his familiars.

npc_dota_hero_visage.name: visage_faithful_followers
npc_dota_hero_visage.title: Faithful Followers
npc_dota_hero_visage.description: Familiars automatically move with Visage and attack his targets.

npc_dota_hero_visage.name: visage_gold_assumption
npc_dota_hero_visage.title: Death Toll
npc_dota_hero_visage.description: Soul Assumption kills give bonus gold. Visage can also recall his familiars.

npc_dota_hero_slark.name: slark_leeching_leash
npc_dota_hero_slark.title: Leeching Leash
npc_dota_hero_slark.description: Pounce applies stacks of Essence Shift when striking enemy heroes.

npc_dota_hero_slark.name: slark_dark_reef_renegade
npc_dota_hero_slark.title: Dark Reef Renegade
npc_dota_hero_slark.description: Barracuda lingers after being revealed to the enemy if Slark is not nearby allied heroes. Slark's attacks reduce the target's armor while Slark is under the effects of Barracuda.

npc_dota_hero_slark.name: slark_slark
npc_dota_hero_slark.title: Fugitive
npc_dota_hero_slark.description: This facet doesn't do anything. Slark is still reeling from nightmares about Dark Reef...

npc_dota_hero_medusa.name: medusa_engorged
npc_dota_hero_medusa.title: Engorged
npc_dota_hero_medusa.description: Mystic Snake grants Medusa attack damage.

npc_dota_hero_medusa.name: medusa_mana_pact
npc_dota_hero_medusa.title: Mana Pact
npc_dota_hero_medusa.description: Medusa can gain attack speed at the cost of mana over time.

npc_dota_hero_medusa.name: medusa_undulation
npc_dota_hero_medusa.title: Undulation
npc_dota_hero_medusa.description: Medusa's movement speed is fixed at 310 (465 during Stone Gaze). Medusa is unslowable and does not benefit from movement speed increases.

npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.name: troll_warlord_insensitive
npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.title: Insensitive
npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.description: Fervor grants armor per stack while in melee form.

npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.name: troll_warlord_bad_influence
npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.title: Bad Influence
npc_dota_hero_troll_warlord.description: During Battle Trance, Troll Warlord has increased max Fervor stacks and no attack speed limit. Battle Trance grants allied heroes {s:bonus_attack_speed_share_percent}% of the attack speed bonus.

npc_dota_hero_centaur.name: centaur_counter_strike
npc_dota_hero_centaur.title: Counter-Strike
npc_dota_hero_centaur.description: Double Edge damage is increased when Centaur is damage by enemies.

npc_dota_hero_centaur.name: centaur_horsepower
npc_dota_hero_centaur.title: Horsepower
npc_dota_hero_centaur.description:
Centaur Warrunner gains 30% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

 This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

npc_dota_hero_magnataur.name: magnataur_reverse_polarity
npc_dota_hero_magnataur.title: Reverse Polarity Facet
npc_dota_hero_magnataur.description: Reverse Polarity pulls all nearby enemies in.

npc_dota_hero_magnataur.description: Empower is always on Magnus. Each subsequent attack increases its power.

npc_dota_hero_magnataur.name: magnataur_diminishing_return
npc_dota_hero_magnataur.title: Diminishing Return
npc_dota_hero_magnataur.description: Increases the max level of Shockwave. Level {s:bonus_max_level_tooltip} Shockwave causes it to return towards Magnus's location.

npc_dota_hero_magnataur.name: magnataur_reverse_reverse_polarity
npc_dota_hero_magnataur.title: Reverse Reverse Polarity
npc_dota_hero_magnataur.description: Reverse Polarity pushes enemies away all around Magnus.

npc_dota_hero_shredder.name: shredder_shredder

npc_dota_hero_bristleback.name: bristleback_berserk

npc_dota_hero_bristleback.description: Warpath grants scaling Attack Speed instead of Damage.

npc_dota_hero_bristleback.name: bristleback_seeing_red
npc_dota_hero_bristleback.title: Seeing Red

npc_dota_hero_tusk.name: tusk_facet_tag_team

npc_dota_hero_tusk.name: tusk_facet_fist_bump
npc_dota_hero_tusk.title: Drinking Buddies
npc_dota_hero_tusk.description: Tusk can cast Drinking Buddies, pulling him and a teammate closer and granting both bonus Movement Speed and Attack Damage.

npc_dota_hero_skywrath_mage.name: skywrath_mage_shield

npc_dota_hero_elder_titan.description: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.

npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.name: legion_commander_stonehall_plate

npc_dota_hero_earth_spirit.name: earth_spirit_resonance

Level 3 - Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes.

npc_dota_hero_grimstroke.name: grimstroke_inkstigate

npc_dota_hero_hoodwink.name: hoodwink_hunter
